# CoasterCar

A single wooden-coaster car with seated riders, modelled from the RCT2 vehicle sprite. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# Guest

A park guest with an animated walk cycle, modelled from the RCT2 peep sprite. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# OakTree

An oak tree with chunky foliage that sways, modelled from the RCT2 scenery sprite. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# Road

A paved road tile with kerbs and centre line, modelled from the RCT2 tarmac footpath. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# WoodenCoaster

Wooden roller-coaster track + riding train, modelled from the RCT2 sprite (rails, ties, wooden support bents). Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 — 3D Rigs

Real-time **three.js** models of RCT2 assets, hand-built to match the original
isometric sprites (their 4 rotations are the modelling reference). Unlike the
sprite design system, these are true 3D and can be freely orbited, lit and
animated.

## Architecture
- **Stage** — the shared viewport (renderer, orbit camera, sun + soft shadows,
  grass ground) + geometry helpers `box` / `cyl` / `ball` / `mat`. Every rig is
  `<Stage build={(THREE, group) => { ... }} />`.
- Each rig's `build` populates a group and may return `(t) => void` to animate.

## Starter rigs (this version)
- **WoodenCoaster** — a run of wooden track (rails, ties, support bents) with a
  2-car train riding a loop. *(the roller coaster)*
- **CoasterCar** — one detailed car with seated riders. *(the roller-coaster car)*
- **Guest** — an animated walking peep.
- **OakTree** — swaying scenery.
- **Road** — a paved path tile with kerbs + centre line.

## How to model a new rig (be particular)
1. Open the matching sprite in the *RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 — Real Assets* system
   and study all 4 rotations for silhouette, colour and part breakdown.
2. Compose from `box`/`cyl`/`ball` in world units (1 unit ~= one tile edge;
   a guest is ~1.1 tall). Match the sprite's palette.
3. Anchor to the ground (feet / base at y=0). Add an `update(t)` for anything
   the sprite animates (wheels, walk cycle, sway, spinning platforms).
4. Keep integer-ish proportions and readable, chunky forms — these are stylised
   theme-park models, not photoreal.
